Word: Biodegradable
Root: degrade
Affixes: Bio- (prefix), -able (suffix)

Word: environment
Root: viron (from Latin 'virere', to live/green, though often treated as a bound root in modern analysis) or simply 'environ' as the base
Affixes: -ment (suffix)
Note: In strict morphological analysis, 'environment' is often analyzed as 'en-' (prefix meaning 'in') + 'viron' (root/base) + '-ment' (suffix). However, 'viron' is not a standalone word in English. A more common breakdown for learners is:
Prefix: en-
Root: viron (bound)
Suffix: -ment

Word: naturally
Root: natural
Affixes: -ly (suffix)
